page_title: REI 0-1 ANG | Reims v Angers 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The free kick is delivered by Sekine Hiroki (Reims) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
90+5' Florent Batta blows his whistle and signals a foul after Florent Hanin (Angers) brought his opponent down.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Florent Batta blows his whistle and it's Cedric Kipre (Reims) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' Cedric Kipre (Reims) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
86' Cedric Kipre (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
85' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
84' The free kick is taken by Sekine Hiroki (Reims), but ball is cleared.
81' My Gran could have done better! Farid El Melali (Angers) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
80' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
78' The game has come to an end for Esteban Lepaul (Angers). He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pierrick Capelle.
78' It's time for a substitution. Sidiki Cherif comes on in place of Zinedine Ferhat (Angers).
73' Here is a change. Valentin Atangana Edoa is going off and Samba Diawara gives the last tactical orders to Teddy Teuma (Reims).
71' The ball ricochets out to Esteban Lepaul (Angers) and he blasts a first-time shot towards goal from inside the box, but the effort flies high over the bar.
70' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Esteban Lepaul (Angers) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

70' Keito Nakamura (Reims) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Yahia Fofana, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
66' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) will be replaced by Ibrahima Niane.
66' A pass by Keito Nakamura (Reims) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
64' Oumar Diakite (Reims) doesn't keep his cool and fails to convert the penalty. He skies the ball way over the bar and into the stands.
64' Oumar Diakite (Reims) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
63' The referee gives a yellow card to Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
61' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A penalty is given to Reims!
59' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner which is cleared.

59' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Reims.
57' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
56' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) makes a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
48' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Samba Diawara gives a chance to Sekine Hiroki and Buta (Reims) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Nhoa Sangui (Reims) is replaced by Amadou Kone.
46' Samba Diawara has made a change at the break. Oumar Diakite has come on in place of Mory Gbane (Reims).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Florent Batta has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' 0 - 1 Farid El Melali (Angers) displays his brilliant free kick ability. The ball flies towards the goal and ends under the crossbar. What a finish!
45+1' Farid El Melali (Angers) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
45+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Farid El Melali (Angers) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
43' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. It will be a corner kick for Angers.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Buta (Reims) was quite harsh and Florent Batta didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' The corner from Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) is cleared away by the defence.
40' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Esteban Lepaul (Angers) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
38' Alexandre Dujeux is forced to make a change. Jim Allevinah is unable to continue due to injury, Farid El Melali (Angers) comes on.

37' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Yahia Fofana was alert and the score remains the same.
35' Jim Allevinah (Angers) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
33' Jim Allevinah (Angers) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
32' Mory Gbane (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florent Batta had an easy-decision to make.
28' Mory Gbane (Reims) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
24' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
23' Keito Nakamura (Reims) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off the line to clear the ball away.
21' Angers can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
18' Florent Batta blows his whistle after Joseph Okumu (Reims) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
16' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
13' Keito Nakamura (Reims) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
12' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) commits a foul and Florent Batta immediately signals a free kick.
11' The Reims players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
9' Keito Nakamura (Reims) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
5' It doesn’t look good for Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
4' Jordan Lefort (Angers) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.

4' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
3' There's an opportunity for Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

3' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Angers will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

3' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Reims will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta is the one to supervise the game today.
